description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [MAG and MND +50% (25s)], [Attach Water with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Instructor Mode I (Quistis - Water)] and [Water Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Attach Water with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Dual Awoken Instructor Mode I (Quistis - Water)
description.text: Water abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Water abilities trigger 2 additional times, grants [Quick Cast 1] to all allies in the character's row after using Water abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (8s)], grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Instructor Mode II (Quistis - Water)] to the user, removes [Dual Awoken Instructor Mode I (Quistis - Water)] from the user
